name: Generalizable Pathology Foundation Model Benchmark
description: A comprehensive benchmark to evaluate the performance of foundation models across six distinct clinical task types in computational pathology, encompassing 72 specific tasks. It measures the generalization ability of pathology foundation models on a broad spectrum of clinical tasks.
reputation: A recent pathology benchmark that is gaining attention for broad, multi-task evaluation of foundation models, but is not yet as established as older pathology datasets.
notes: Benchmark covers six clinical task types with 72 tasks; evaluates off-the-shelf foundation models and the proposed GPFM model.
